description: This file implements the Poly1305 one-time message authentication code, including functions for generating authenticators, verifying them, and a MAC type for incremental processing.

classes.name: MAC
classes.description: A struct implementing the Poly1305 MAC with methods for writing data, computing the sum, and verification.

methods.name: Sum
methods.description: Generates a 16-byte authenticator for a message using a one-time key.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies if a given MAC is valid for a message and key.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new MAC instance with a specified key.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the authenticator in bytes.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Adds data to the MAC for incremental processing.

methods.name: Sum
methods.description: Computes the authenticator for all data written so far.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Checks if the computed MAC matches the expected value.
